note: Commercially he sits squarely inside the ICP: Zurich-based, already paying a nutrition practitioner and planning to add a physio, and he absorbed $6,000/6mo, $9,000/12mo and the franc and euro conversions without one affordability remark — willingness to pay is clearly there. He is not deconditioned (ex-CrossFit, ex-gym, active, training at home) and he frames the buy as upgrading his method for the next decade rather than being rescued. He misses on neglected health: his health is the thing he is actively managing, with practitioners already engaged, so the tension the pitch relies on is absent. 'Successful' is untested rather than failed — occupation was never asked once in 32 minutes, which is itself a qualification failure given the ICP screens on it. The criterion that would actually have decided this call, whether his spine can perform loaded ballistic work, does not exist in the stated ICP at all.
